2. Daily Summary
Today I walked the job site and documented the crew's progress and safety practices. Interior work continued throughout the building, with workers installing sheetrock and cutting sheets at ground level, and finishers working on the walls. Joint compound, cement board, and sheetrock were stacked neatly in designated areas, out of everyone's way, and the finishers had mixing stations set up where they bring their compound to mix. Workers on scissor lifts were tied off 100% of the time. A sheetrock dolly was accessible so that sheets can be carried to their destination without excessive heavy lifting. I also checked several workers for PPE.
